description: Synthetic format modeled on public documentation, not a real instrument file: controller family 1 writes three logs. The tag log has a UTC stamp with offset, the tag, the value and the quality; the tag name is unit tag, signal and role (A171). The alarm log follows the ISA-18.2 states (A174) and the batch-phase log the ISA-88 hierarchy and phase states (A170). Logging by deadband and maximum interval (A172, A178, A179).
